You will spend your time defining the high-level parameters of a scent—its emotional target, its stability requirements, and its cost constraints—while AI suggests the molecular structures most likely to succeed. This allows you to bypass months of failed lab tests, moving straight to the most promising candidates.

You will oversee automated systems that handle the precision of sample prep and quality control, freeing you to focus on the complex translation of a brand's identity into a chemical formula.
